Bill.BriefDescription: Exempting property owners from injury caused to another person as a result of metal theft.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to exempting property owners from injury caused toanother person as a result of metal theft; and adding a new section tochapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A public or private landowner or the possessor of land is notcivilly liable for a person's injuries caused by: (a) The theft orattempted theft, by the person or a third party, of copper, aluminum,steel, or other metal material from the property of the landowner orpossessor; or (b) a dangerous condition created as a result of thetheft or attempted theft of copper, aluminum, steel, or other metalmaterial from property of the landowner or the possessor when thelandowner or possessor did not know and could not have reasonably knownof the dangerous condition. (2) This section does not create or impose a duty of care upon alandowner or possessor of land that would not otherwise exist under p. 1 SHB 1987common law.
